To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
research training and supervision should be enhanced in nursing colleges to improve the research culture in nursing education.
the research culture in nursing schools needs to be enhanced.
the research culture of institutions needs to be enhanced by implementing strategies that could be used by nurse educators and students to improve research capacities and skills.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a research culture and the scholarship of discovery in nursing colleges.
enhancing the research culture in nursing education.
how to enhance the research capacity in institutions offering nursing programmes, in order to improve nursing research in South Africa and in Africa as a whole.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the scholarship of discovery can be enhanced in nursing colleges by implementing strategies such as: a) research mentors; b) research training and supervision; c) support and mentorship; d) research capacity building; and e) research training programmes.

the implementation of a strategy to enhance the research capacity of nursing students and nurse educators in nursing colleges would improve the scholarship of discovery and research culture in nursing education.

the scholarship of discovery is an important component of the scholarship of teaching, and the research culture should be enhanced by providing research training for all stakeholders in higher education institutions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the scholarship of nursing in higher education depends on the research capacity of the institution and its nurse educators and students, and that the research capacity of institutions needs to be improved in order to enhance the scholarship of nursing.

a research culture in institutions can be enhanced if institutions implement strategies to support nurse educators in improving their research capacities and students in enhancing their research skills.

the scholarship of discovery in nursing colleges can be enhanced if institutions implement strategies to support nurse educators in enhancing their own research capacity, and support students to become competent in research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nursing schools should become role models and mentors to enhance a research culture in the colleges.
nursing colleges and learning centres should be supported to enhance the research capacity and culture.
nursing colleges should develop a research culture and that this is the responsibility of all nursing staff and students.
